summarize_TokenKinds: summarize the TokenKinds list that maps CXTokenKind values to libclang token types
review_TokenKinds: review the TokenKinds enumeration defining PUNCTUATION, KEYWORD, IDENTIFIER, LITERAL, and COMMENT token kinds
build_token_lookup: build a lookup table from the TokenKinds list to map token names to their integer values
create_token_parser: create a function that uses TokenKinds to classify libclang tokens by their kind
test_TokenKinds: test the TokenKinds list to verify all five CXTokenKind entries are present and correctly ordered
